detail: Verification for issue #30 (kill decision→blackboard cross-post): (1) DecisionEngine.decide embeds each decision independently into the "decisions" embedding index — src/engine/decisions.ts (embedder + indexManager.addEntry("decisions", ...)). (2) SearchEngine.searchDecisions loads that index (src/embeddings/search.ts:132) with keyword fallback; DecisionEngine.searchDecisions has its own fallback too. (3) ContextAssembler already searches decisions via searchEngine.searchDecisions (src/engine/context-assembler.ts:108). (4) BlackboardEngine.query only searches blackboard embeddings, so twining_query must be extended to also call searchDecisions — doing that in the tool handler. (5) decisions.ts has TWO entry_type "decision" cross-posts: decide() and override() — both are filtered by assemble's entry_type!=="decision" filter, removing both. Legacy mirrors on disk (1,412 in heaviest field repo) remain; housekeeping/archive compaction (archive-35's area) could archive them later — out of scope here.
summary: #30 verified: decisions embed into their own 'decisions' index (search.ts:132 reads it) — killing the cross-post keeps semantic search intact; twining_query must merge searchDecisions.
